pages.title: Listen and answer
pages.instruction: Kim needs to change the plan. Listen, find the new time and get ready to reply
pages.message: I’m not free on Thursday evening. I work until eight. Are you free on Friday at seven? Let’s go to the gym then. We can meet there. Please tell me if Friday is good for you
